# High-School Half-Yearly Physics Examination

## Section A

**Q1.** A uniform disc of mass $M$ and radius $R$ rolls without slipping down an inclined plane of inclination $\theta$. The acceleration of the center of mass is given by:
(a) $g \sin\theta$
(b) $\frac{2}{3} g \sin\theta$
(c) $\frac{1}{2} g \sin\theta$
(d) $\frac{5}{7} g \sin\theta$

**Q2.** The experimental data for three trials is tabulated below:

| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| 1 | 10.0 | 0.50 | 5.0 |
| 2 | 20.0 | 0.25 | 5.0 |
| 3 | 30.0 | 0.16 | 4.8 |

**Q3.** Two coherent monochromatic light sources produce interference fringes on a screen. If the path difference at a point on the screen is given by $\Delta x = n\lambda$, determine the condition for constructive interference.
